provenance.correction_reason: Gross facing defect: initial E/W columns were front three-quarter instead of true profiles.

references.role: Primary current runtime identity, costume, palette and proportions
Supporting costume detail and directional anatomy
Retro pixel-art style only, no labels/races/props treated as canonical

source_size_review.method: Visual inspection of generated original and copied original with view_image at original detail; metadata and alpha counts read through System.Drawing without edits.
observations: Exactly 8 columns and 4 rows of complete full-body vampire figures; no visible cropped ears, hair, fingertips, boot soles or coat tails.
Pale skin, red eyes, black swept-back hair, pointed ears, black/deep-red costume, high collar and gold belt/trim retained.
Hands are empty; no weapons, magic, environment, text, cell borders or ground shadows observed.
Correction makes E/W more side-on with one visible eye; front, back and back-quarter headings remain readable.
Rising row tucks the feet and extends arms outward; descending row lengthens downward with altered arm placement.
Head/skull size appears broadly stable across rows at source resolution, but exact native continuity is unmeasured.
limitations: Profile shoulders retain some three-quarter width; exact strict-profile silhouette should be reviewed at native scale.
Descending legs remain asymmetric with one bent/tucked leg in multiple headings; both-feet-ready readability is not uniformly strong.
Landing-versus-anticipation compression is subtle in several front/rear headings; the deeper landing requirement is not unambiguously established across all eight headings.
The targeted correction slightly changed other columns despite preservation instructions; final sheet is a new whole-source candidate, not a pixel-identical partial patch.
Generated alpha is mostly partial for foreground pixels. Threshold cleanup and hidden-RGB treatment, if approved, are lead-owned assembly work and were not performed.
Uniform registration, exact head/body measurement, downsampling, small-scale silhouette readability and animation timing are unverified.
Four key poses only, not complete animation cycles or authored casting actions.
